deviations.what: t1 adds a generic register_migration hook to core/store.py (MIGRATIONS list, run after the DDL on every open) so eval_store.py can run its ensure-columns step; the items-kinds rebuild is untouched
deviations.reason: store.register_schema only executes plain DDL, and a conditional ALTER TABLE ADD COLUMN for a missing column cannot be written in SQL, so the instruction's 'only eval_store.py' could not be met without a hack

deviations.what: t2's id_metrics reports MRR and nDCG as mrr and ndcg with an explicit depth field = min(10, k_run) instead of mrr_at_10/ndcg_at_10; found_at_10 stays None for k below 10
deviations.reason: a k=5 run cannot measure depth 10; naming top-5 values '@10' would mislead a compare view (decider via /assess: depth_field 0.92 vs 0.04/0.03), while criterion 3 still needs MRR from k=5 runs

deviations.what: radar axes follow the suite registry: core/eval_radar gains set_axis_source/axis_names/HANDLED_METRICS, eval/suites installs the source, routes_eval_views uses axis_names(); t15's xfail removed
deviations.reason: t15 found the radar axes hard-coded (AXES tuple), so a newly registered suite never reached the radar, against c35/h27; fixing it needs edits to eval_radar, the suites package and the views route, which t15's criterion ('no edits to runner, routes or site') excluded
